result.title: SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation
result.summary: Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards (\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \textbf{text-to-video generation} and \textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPAR：以世界模型的预测误差作为推理期奖励来提升视频生成的物理合理性，并用「重复自身帧构成的静态片段」作为内容匹配参考来抵消场景易预测性带来的偏差，同时对奖励做空间局部化与时序峰值抑制的细化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用内容匹配参考基线校正预测误差」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中如何把 latent 预测一致性信号与内容难度、信息坍缩造成的伪信号分离；时空细化中「预测变化与观测变化的一致性」也可为 latent 状态更新与证据筛选的度量设计提供线索。
